headline: Macro Headwinds Persist; Operating Leverage Remains Intact

highlights: EBITDA margin came in at 16.7% (vs CIE est. of 15.6%), up 120 bps on a YoY basis. ▪ Adj.
PAT for the full quarter came in at INR 841 Mn (vs CIE est. of INR 960 Mn), up 24.6% YoY.

Reported EPS for the quarter came in at INR 7.0 Organic Momentum Sustains; Classic Vacation Offers Incremental Upside TBOTEK reported a resilient quarter despite continued macro headwinds, with reported revenue growing 52.5% YoY, including the contribution from the Classic Vacation (CV) acquisition, while organic revenue grew 14% YoY.
Strong growth across Europe and APAC (30% and 25%, respectively), alongside continued growth in the Middle East despite disruption, indicates underlying business resilience.
